# Documentation Templates

This directory contains reusable templates for project documentation.

## Available Templates

| Template | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `FEATURE_DOCUMENTATION_TEMPLATE.md` | Standard template for documenting new features |
| `EPIC_DOCUMENTATION_TEMPLATE.md` | Standard template for documenting epics |
| `ARCHITECTURE_NOTES_TEMPLATE.md` | Standard template for documenting architecture decisions and design rationale |

## Usage

1. Copy the relevant template to `docs/` with a descriptive name (e.g., `CB-1117-date-range-filter.md` or `CB-1100-epic-polish-and-testing.md`)
2. Fill in all sections, replacing placeholder text
3. Update the **Status** field as work progresses:
   - **Features:** `Draft` > `In Review` > `Approved` > `Implemented`
   - **Epics:** `Draft` > `In Review` > `Approved` > `In Progress` > `Completed`
   - **Architecture Notes:** `Draft` > `In Review` > `Approved` > `Superseded`

## Examples

| Example | Template Used | Description |
|---------|--------------|-------------|
| `EXAMPLE_FEATURE_DATE_RANGE_FILTER.md` | Feature | Completed feature doc for Date Range Filter (CB-1112) |
| `EXAMPLE_EPIC_POLISH_AND_TESTING.md` | Epic | In-progress epic doc for Polish & Testing (E7) |
| `EXAMPLE_ARCHITECTURE_DATE_FILTERING.md` | Architecture Notes | Architecture decisions for date-based filtering & sorting |
